description: SwiftUI view components for managing permissions and location settings in a macOS app. Includes views for displaying and requesting various system permissions related to location, notifications, accessibility, and more.

classes.name: PermissionsSettings
classes.description: Main view for displaying and managing various permission settings, including refresh and onboarding actions.

classes.name: LocationAccessSettings
classes.description: View for configuring location access modes and handling location authorization requests.

classes.name: PermissionStatusList
classes.description: View displaying a list of permission capabilities and their current statuses with refresh capability.

classes.name: PermissionRow
classes.description: Component representing individual permission controls, allowing grant actions and displaying status.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles permission request flow for a specific capability, ensuring sequential updates and refreshes.

methods.name: refreshStatusTransitions
methods.description: Performs multiple refreshes with delays to ensure permission status updates settle.

methods.name: requestLocationAuthorization
methods.description: Asynchronously requests location authorization based on the selected mode, handling denied or disabled scenarios.
